# just jokes:

> Live pop-up stand-up comedy in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. (Almost) every single week.

just jokes: is a pop-up stand-up comedy show based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Shows play pop-up venues around KL and tour Melaka, George Town (Penang),
Ipoh and Johor Bahru. 250+ shows since the first show in George Town, Penang
on 8 Sept 2022. Formats include pop-up shows, New Jokes Night, Working It Out,
Headliners' Night, one-man shows, Versus, open mics and stand-up workshops.

## Tickets

- Tickets range from RM40 to RM60 depending on the show. Buy direct to save
  on ticketing fees.
- Buy on CloudJoi (credit cards and almost all digital payments) via each
  show's ticket button, or message WhatsApp (+60 11-3346 6357) and pay direct
  by QR / bank in transfer.
- Example: Fattah Azeem's Bad Advice, 28 Nov 2026, Pelíšky Kuala Lumpur, RM 60.

## Booking / private shows

- Corporate comedy nights, birthdays, weddings, launches, team offsites.
- Email hello@justjokesmy.com or WhatsApp with date and crowd.
